caption: Figure 12. Physical assessment of residual HMD–MoCap alignment after application-level clock mapping. Quest RenderPredicted CenterEye and HMD-mounted optical rigid-body poses were compared in the PC reference-time domain during the same head motion. (a) Held-out 3D trajectories after temporal alignment and frozen rigid registration. (b) Translation, rotation, and equal-weight cross-correlations for MoCap(t) versus Quest(t + τ); the primary across-window median was approximately −6.98 ms. (c) Nine 12-s windows (1-s step; 11-s overlap) summarize within-recording stability; shading indicates mean ± SD, the dashed line the median, and the star the representative window. (d) Aligned standardized translation-speed profiles in that 12-s window.
